# Suraj Van Verma — bythebug

> Backend engineer, AIML specialist, and content creator. I build ML systems and LLM infrastructure by day and make software engineering videos for YouTube under the bythebug brand.

## About

Suraj Van Verma is a software engineer specializing in backend systems, machine learning, and AI/LLM tooling. He runs the bythebug brand — a YouTube channel, Instagram, and Spotify presence focused on software engineering and building in public. Based in India.

Skills: Python, Go, distributed systems, LLM infrastructure, ML pipelines, Redis, Kafka, AWS, iOS development.

## Projects

- [LLM Studio](https://github.com/bythebug/llm-studio): Full-stack platform for fine-tuning LLMs with a job queue, remote GPU dispatch, and experiment tracking.
- [ML Forge](https://github.com/bythebug/ml-forge): Feature engineering pipeline with 12 transformation techniques across 5 ML models.
- [Smart Suggest](https://github.com/bythebug/smart-suggest): Recommendation engine with a built-in A/B testing framework and KPI tracking.
- [Market Graph](https://github.com/bythebug/StockNet-Network-Based-Portfolio-Analyzer): Models the S&P 500 as a network graph using PageRank to identify market-driving stocks.
- [Data Lens](https://github.com/bythebug/data-lens): Self-serve analytics platform with full-text search, filtering, aggregation, and time-series queries.
- [Vani AI](https://github.com/bythebug/Vani-AI): LLM chatbot infrastructure for WhatsApp — multi-model routing over a single messaging layer.
- [Salary Prediction](https://github.com/bythebug/Salary-Prediction-Web-App): ML-powered salary predictor with interactive visualizations. 90% accuracy, deployed on AWS.
- [AI Image Detector](https://aiimagedetector.netlify.app/): Detects AI-generated images by reading embedded content provenance metadata — fully browser-side.
- [iDoList](https://github.com/bythebug/idolist): Life-management app to organize goals, tasks, and habits into one executable dashboard.
- [UML Canvas](https://github.com/bythebug/lld-viz): Type Python, get a live UML class diagram. Zero setup, runs entirely in the browser.
- [Claude Monitor](https://github.com/bythebug/claude-monitor): macOS menu bar app showing Claude Code usage percentage and session reset time.
- [PubSub Hub](https://github.com/bythebug/realtime-hub): Redis pub/sub fan-out with circuit breakers that isolate slow consumers.
- [Distributed Log Processor](https://github.com/bythebug/Real-Time-Distributed-Log-Processing-System): Processes 500K+ events/second — Kafka ingest with consumer groups and Redis-based deduplication.
- [URLtrim](https://github.com/bythebug/urltrim): Personal URL shortener with custom aliases, click analytics, and rate limiting.

## Blog

- [The Wave We're Standing In: Notes on AI in September 2026](https://bythebug.github.io/blog/the-wave-we-are-standing-in/): A narrative tour through where AI actually stands right now: the releases, the timeline arguments, the physical bottlenecks, and the books that saw pieces of it coming.
